texts.en:
Having encountered unknown entities in the blackness of space, we should attempt to establish communications. 

This can be achieved by selecting First Contact in the Situation Log and clicking the Show First Contact button, or alternatively, by clicking the First Contact icon on the Galaxy Map to access it directly.
